evidence.note: Claim: main is red on 6 tests for two drift causes, not a production regression. Mechanism: (1) commit 84da233f4 'orchestrator fill-order' registered recover_first+unphased_first into schedule._filters.ORDER, but test_plan_pipeline.py pinned the pre-feature ORDER ['bugs_first','priority','id']; (2) 5 redaction test files embed private-IP fixtures ([REDACTED:ipv4]/[REDACTED:ipv4]/[REDACTED:ipv4]/[REDACTED:ipv4]/[REDACTED:ipv4]/[REDACTED:ipv4]) that tripped test_repo_is_generic's aggregate scan. Refuting observation: the tests would stay red after any production-code edit. Verified: git log -S recover_first showed 84da233f4 as the sole adder; running the 6 named tests on the worktree FAILED 3 (2 plan_pipeline ORDER, 1 repo_generic scan) and the cheap patch (no production change) turned all 6 green.
